quotes.text: 'Bad things' [for you] in return for benefits [for me].
quotes.author: neonnoodle
quotes.source: Hacker News — Accept 'bad things' in return for benefits of AI, says Sam Altman
quotes.extraction_note: The bracketed edit of Altman's quote is surgical — recontextualizing who bears the 'bad things' vs who collects the benefits. Punchy, standalone, thermonuclear take.
